urbanAgility.heading: Engineered for Kathmandu’s living streets.
urbanAgility.description: Built around the physical realities of the Valley: 175 mm elevated ground clearance, responsive 35 kW electric power, and practical 5-door geometry.
urbanAgility.clearanceDesc: Clear high speed humps, uneven brick pavers, and monsoon road transitions with zero underbody scraping.
urbanAgility.rangeDesc: 240 km on Base Variant, up to 340 km on Top (Premium) Variant.
urbanAgility.motorDesc: Instant electric drive engineered for steep Valley ascents.
urbanAgility.cabinDesc: Comfortable upright 4-passenger cabin geometry for everyday Kathmandu utility.
